basic_details.job_title: IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Computer Science & Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology, Roorkee has 1 JRF post on an ANRF-sponsored research project titled "A comprehensive security analysis of NIST Accordion mode proposals and their implications to has functions over Galois fields". The post runs for 1 Years and pays Rs. 37000 + HRA. Indian nationals with the required degree, selected through CSIR-UGC NET, GATE or another listed national-level examination, and with a CGPA above 7.5 (or at least 75% marks) can apply. Applications go by email to the Principal Investigator by 25 October 2026, 11

how_to_apply: Applications go by email to the office of the Principal Investigator at [email protected]. They must be sent by 25 October 2026, 11:59 PM. Candidates should first check that they meet the eligibility for the post.
important_instructions: The selected candidate may get an opportunity for PhD admission. If selected, the candidate will join the position as soon as possible.

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee JRF at a Glance
content_sections.text: Register for Job Alerts The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: A comprehensive security analysis of NIST Accordion mode proposals and their implications to has functions over Galois fields

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals can apply. The notice prints the essential qualifications for the JRF post in three parts: Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course, selected through any one of the following: a. Scholars who are selected through National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE. b. The selection process through National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MOE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISC, IISER, NISER etc. M.E./ MTech. in Information Tech./Computer Science & Engineering OR B.E. / B.Tech. in Computer Sc. & Engineering / Information Technology/ Mathematics and Computing or equivalent OR Five years integrated BS-MS in Mathematics and Computing or equivalent. CGPA above 7.5 (or at least 75% marks). Desirable: Experience in cryptography and cybersecurity along with a solid background in programming. When candidates have equal qualifications and experience, preference will be given to SC/ST candidates. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee JRF Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following work for the JRF: Rijndael-256 security analysis Accordion mode classical and quantum cryptanalysis with automated tools Accordion mode implementation and benchmarking in software and hardware platforms New 256-bit block cipher design Analysis of hash functions over Galois Fields

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Roorkee JRF
content_sections.text: Applications go by email to the office of the Principal Investigator at [email protected] . They must be sent by 25 October 2026, 11:59 PM. Candidates should first check that they meet the eligibility for the post. CV Degree Certificates Experience Certificates

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be selected through an interview. Shortlisted candidates will get the interview schedule by email. At the interview, candidates must bring their original degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) for verification. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.

rows.event: Last date to submit application by email

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The selected candidate may get an opportunity for PhD admission. If selected, the candidate will join the position as soon as possible.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the IIT Roorkee JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 JRF vacancy, on an ANRF-sponsored project in the Department of Computer Science & Engineering at IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Roorkee JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date is 25 October 2026, 11:59 PM. Applications must reach the office of the Principal Investigator by email by then.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the IIT Roorkee JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science or a Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course, selected through CSIR-UGC NET, GATE or another listed national-level examination. They also need M.E./MTech. in Information Tech./Computer Science & Engineering, B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Sc. & Engineering / Information Technology / Mathematics and Computing or equivalent, or a five-year integrated BS-MS in Mathematics and Computing or equivalent, and a CGPA above 7.5 (or at least 75% marks).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the IIT Roorkee JRF?
faq.answer: The emoluments for the IIT Roorkee JRF post are Rs. 37000 + HRA.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the IIT Roorkee JRF pay?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice gives the emoluments as Rs. 37000 + HRA, so HRA is paid in addition to Rs. 37000.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the IIT Roorkee JRF post?
faq.answer: Email your application to [email protected] by 25 October 2026, 11:59 PM. Attach your CV, degree certificates and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the IIT Roorkee JRF?
faq.answer: Selection is through an interview. Shortlisted candidates will get the interview schedule by email and must bring their original degree and experience certificates for verification.

faq.question: Q8. Is the IIT Roorkee JRF a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a project position on an ANRF-sponsored research project, and its duration is 1 Years.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the IIT Roorkee JRF interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can the IIT Roorkee JRF lead to PhD admission?
faq.answer: Possibly. The notice says the selected candidate may get an opportunity for PhD admission.
